clrs.title: Introduction to Algorithms
clrs.authors: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest and Clifford Stein

algorithm-fundamentals-and-analysis.read: Chapters 1–3 (role of algorithms, getting started, running times); Chapter 16: Amortized Analysis

divide-and-conquer.why: Recurrences, the substitution and recursion-tree methods and the master method.

greedy-and-randomized-algorithms.why: The greedy-choice property, Huffman codes and randomized algorithms.
